verdict.rationale: llamafile is a local LLM runtime and server, so serving LoRA adapters on a base model is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions LoRA adapters, loading adapters, or switching between them. It only covers GGUF model support, server/slot options and single-file bundling, none of which shows adapter serving.

support.subject: As a developer, I can efficiently serve multiple LoRA adapters on top of a base model
